name: Conv2d

whatIsIt.eli5: A tiny window of learned numbers slides over the notes and adds up what it sees at each spot.
whatIsIt.simple: The raw convolution: slides k×k learned kernels over all input channels and sums the products into each output channel.
whatIsIt.engineer: nn.Conv2d(c1, c2, k, s, p, groups=g, dilation=d, bias=False). MACs = H_out·W_out·c2·(c1/g)·k².

whyExists.eli5: It is how the model finds patterns.
whyExists.simple: It finds local patterns with few weights, because the same kernel is used everywhere.

eli5: Lay the window on the notes.
simple: Multiply kernel and patch element by element.
Slide by the stride and repeat for every output channel.
engineer: y[o,i,j] = Σ_c Σ_{u,v} W[o,c,u,v]·x[c, s·i+u−p, s·j+v−p].

math: y_{o,i,j} = \sum_{c}\sum_{u,v} W_{o,c,u,v}\, x_{c,\, s i+u-p,\, s j+v-p}
pytorch: nn.Conv2d(c1, c2, kernel_size=k, stride=s, padding=k // 2, groups=g, bias=False)
